We recently made our first technology hire in the country, and we are looking at Poland as a long-term strategic location for senior hires, particularly within our engineering organisation. Joining now means joining early, and helping shape what our presence here becomes. So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Field Verification to join us in Poland.   About the role Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks — verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors — and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team. The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas. An API layer lets other business units push verification requests in and receive results back by webhook, and an assignment algorithm routes each request to an officer close enough to carry it out. We want to be straightforward about the rest. This domain has never had a dedicated engineering leader, and that is the single biggest constraint on it. The team is one lean, cross-functional squad — an Engineering Manager, four engineers and a QA — carrying verification volume for the entire customer base. They have done that impressively well, but running lean means running in keep-the-lights-on mode, and a long list of things that would make this platform substantially better has been waiting for someone to own it. That list is the role. Trip and route management, so an officer can plan an optimal day across several sites rather than making a separate journey for each one — today we pay for a round trip per verification, and the logistics are nowhere near optimal. Capacity management. A native mobile app, wanted for a long time and never resourced. Liveness and identity verification tooling, exposed as APIs the rest of the business can build on. And as Moniepoint expands into markets where identity verification is as difficult as it is in Nigeria, Kenya among them, a platform that works beyond a single country. There is a great deal of room to build here. Whoever takes this on will set the direction rather than inherit someone else's plan, on a system that already carries real weight for the business. As Head of Engineering, Field Verification, your responsibilities will include: Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Field Verification platform end to end, and setting direction for a domain that has been running without dedicated engineering leadership. Moving the platform from keep-the-lights-on operation to deliberate, prioritised development. Leading and growing the existing cross-functional team, and building the organisation out as scope expands. Building the operational efficiency layer — trip and route optimisation, task allocation and capacity management for field officers. Owning the platform's client-facing surface: the APIs and webhooks that other business units integrate with, and the back office those units rely on. Delivering a native mobile experience for field officers. Ensuring verification data is structured, auditable and fit for compliance scrutiny. Building for multi-country expansion as Moniepoint enters new markets. Partnering closely with Product and with the business units that depend on the platform — onboarding, loans, compliance and fraud. Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and hiring and developing engineers and Engineering Managers. Who you are You have built things yourself, and grew into leadership from there. We are explicit about this: we are not looking for someone who moved into management early and has led from a distance since. We want an engineer who became a leader. You are capable across disciplines. Backend, web and mobile. This platform spans all three and you will need credibility in each — a specialist in one layer will struggle here. You have built platforms, not just products. Systems used by several distinct groups of users and internal business units, with the flexibility to serve requirements you did not anticipate. You are a problem solver first. We would rather have someone adaptable than someone with the exact domain experience. Having built across different industries — fintech, e-commerce, logistics or otherwise — is a positive signal, not a scattered CV. You have 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on production engineering and strong backend depth. Our backend environment is Java and Spring Boot. You have at least 5 years of engineering leadership, including managing Engineering Managers. You collaborate well with product and business stakeholders, and can translate operational requirements into engineering solutions. Experience working with location and geospatial data is a strong plus, including map integrations. Experience with route, trip or delivery optimisation is a strong plus. Experience building for compliance — where data must be structured to evidence what was done and when — is a strong plus. Experience with identity, KYC or verification platforms is a plus. None of these four are requirements.   Cultural Alignment As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation. Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets. Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality. Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality. Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early. Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders. No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes. Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not. Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.   What Success Looks Like The domain has clear technical ownership and direction for the first time. The team out of keep-the-lights-on mode and delivering against a prioritised roadmap. Measurable improvement in field officer efficiency — more verifications per trip, lower cost per verification. A native mobile experience shipped for field officers. Verification data that stands up to compliance scrutiny across every business unit the platform serves. The platform ready to support a new market. A team grown beyond its current size, with a strong bench of engineers and managers. Why Join Us A genuinely greenfield mandate on a system that already matters. Every customer Moniepoint onboards passes through this platform. A lean, capable team making outsized impact, and the remit to build the organisation around them. Breadth: backend, web, mobile, location data, compliance and operational optimisation in one domain. Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals. What To Expect in The Hiring Process A preliminary phone call with the recruiter. 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers. 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes. 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business. 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

About The Role POS Hardware and Device Platforms owns the software behind the physical side of Moniepoint's business: the systems that track, move, maintain and account for millions of POS terminals in the field. That covers inventory and warehouse management, logistics and distribution, repair and maintenance workflows, and the operational tooling the business runs on day to day. It is a backend and distributed systems challenge at real scale - making operational data about millions of physical devices visible, trustworthy and consistent across every market we operate in. It is not a hardware engineering role. The Head of Engineering, POS Supply Chain, oversees that software estate and is vital as Moniepoint expands internationally and scales device operations globally. The position involves leading the technical strategy for the domain and managing a large engineering organisation in a remote, distributed environment. As Head of Engineering, Supply Chain, your responsibilities will include: Owning the technical strategy and architecture for inventory and logistics tools and repair management software. Leading an engineering organisation of approximately 25 engineers, including managers, QA, SRE and Data Engineering. Driving platformisation of inventory and supply chain systems so operational data is visible, trustworthy and consistent across millions of terminals. Bridging the gap between operational practice and software systems by building operationally disciplined solutions. Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics across squads to ensure reliability and data integrity. Collaborating with business and operational stakeholders to translate operational requirements into engineering solutions. Hiring, mentoring and developing engineering managers and senior engineers to support team growth up to 30+ members. Who You Are 10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases. 5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it. At least 5 years of experience managing managers - leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team. Deep hands-on experience in supply chain, inventory, warehouse or logistics software at scale. Fintech or regulated-industry experience, with an understanding of the operational stakes of device management in a payments environment. Strong backend engineering skills for data-intensive, distributed, operational systems. Proven system design ability at large scale, managing hundreds of thousands of devices or more. Experience managing and developing large engineering teams of 20 or more members. Excellent stakeholder management, translating complex technical concepts for non-technical leaders. A product-minded approach to solving operational problems with engineering solutions. Cultural Alignment As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation. Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets. Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality. Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality. Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early. Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders. No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes. Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not. Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable. What Success Looks Like In The Role Scalable inventory and logistics systems delivered, supporting millions of devices across multiple countries. A high-performing, motivated engineering team aligned with company growth. Operational data visibility and trust established across multiple global markets. Robust architecture standards enabling reliability and data integrity. Effective collaboration with business and operational teams to meet rapid expansion needs. What we can offer you Lead engineering for one of Africa's largest POS networks and directly influence our global expansion. Work in a fast-paced, innovative environment at the intersection of fintech and hardware operations. title: Head, POS Recovery
description: Who We Are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. Job Title: POS Recovery Manager Department: POS Channel Reports to: VP, POS Channel About this role: This role owns the end-to-end recovery of non-performing POS terminal assets — from the moment a terminal is flagged as at risk through to physical retrieval, financial settlement, and post-write-off recovery. Responsibilities Recovery Strategy Governance Own the terminal recovery lifecycle that defines escalation speed and settlement windows based on terminal age, transaction history, and recovery economics.  Ensure every terminal that enters recovery mode is assigned, tracked, escalated on schedule, and settled within its gate deadline — recovery, write-off, paid write-off, or insurance claim.  Design and continuously refine the recovery strategy, covering device collection, swap logistics, sales agent coordination, external agency management, and the efficient flow of assets back to custody.  Field Team Leadership Lead, manage, and hold accountable a distributed field recovery team across multiple regions.  Instill a culture of operational discipline, accountability, and ethical conduct. Recovery work involves sensitive situations (confronting custodians about lost assets, handling disputes, managing bounty payments); the team must operate with integrity.  Develop comprehensive standard operating procedures for every recovery scenario: BRM-led recovery, external agency coordination, business takeover, faulty terminal collection, voluntary write-off processing, dispute handling, revive processing.  Build training programmes for recovery agents covering: terminal identification, check-in procedures, evidence collection for disputes, GPS and field management tools, escalation protocols.  KPI Management and Recovery Economics Define and track recovery KPIs: recovery rate (pre-write-off), BRM recovery rate, external recovery rate, average days to recovery, cost per recovery, revive rate (post-write-off), bounty efficiency (bounty spend vs recovery value recovered).  Own the recovery economics: ensure total bounty spend plus logistics cost is always less than the recovery value of the terminals retrieved. The programme must be self-funding — recovery must generate more value than it costs.  Report monthly on: terminals entering recovery mode, terminals recovered, terminals written off, terminals revived, net financial impact, bounty spend, external agency spend, dispute volumes and outcomes.  Experience & Background Minimum 7 years of progressive experience managing large-scale field operations, logistics, asset recovery, or after-sales service, with at least 3 years in a senior leadership role.  Experience managing distributed field teams across multiple regions in Nigeria — you understand the infrastructure, the logistics constraints, and the human dynamics of field recovery operations.  Experience managing third-party service providers, contractors, or agency networks with performance-based contracts.  Direct experience in the Nigerian market with its specific logistical, regulatory, and operational realities.  Preferred: Experience from fintech, telecoms, e-commerce logistics, or any high-volume distributed asset management environment.  Preferred: Experience managing asset recovery at scale (thousands of units per month, not dozens).  Skills & Competencies Proven ability to design and implement structured operational processes (SOPs, escalation frameworks, settlement procedures) from scratch or through a major restructure.  Strong analytical capability — you use data to drive decisions, track performance, calculate ROI on recovery spend.  Financial discipline & budget management — experience managing a budget or cost centre, understanding unit economics, and demonstrating net positive recovery value.  Technical & Systems acumen — experience with product management/development lifecycles (writing briefs, working with engineers), GPS tracking, CRM, field management tools, or route optimisation platforms.  Regulatory & Compliance understanding — familiarity with insurance claim processes, write-off accounting, or asset disposal regulations in Nigeria.  What Success Looks Like in This Role Terminal recovery lifecycle is tightly governed, ensuring swift escalation and settlement within established gate deadlines.  Field recovery operations maintain high ethical standards and operational discipline across all regions.  Recovery program operates as a self-funding unit where total recovery value generated consistently exceeds total bounty and logistics expenditure.  Robust systems, SOPs, and field management tools are seamlessly integrated into daily team operations.  Transparent monthly reporting clearly demonstrates positive net financial impact and high recovery/revive rates.  Why Join Us?  Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.  Support for professional development and a dynamic culture driving financial inclusion across Africa.

title: Inventory Support Officer (South East)
description: Who We are Moniepoint Inc is a financial technology company digitizing Africa’s real economy by building a financial ecosystem for businesses, providing them with all the payment, banking, credit and business management tools they need to succeed.  What We do At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community, dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We have several products that provide essential services for businesses such as credit, overdrafts etc. We leverage artificial intelligence and data to make our decisions but also have the technology and data-driven best practices used to support our businesses.  1A. Inventory Support Officer – POS Terminals Role Purpose The ISO (Terminals) is the dedicated custodian for all forms of POS terminals flowing through the repair pipeline. The role ensures end-to-end traceability, enforces custody controls, and maintains absolute logical–physical alignment within the Repair Centre's IMS subsystem, covering every stage from receipt of faulty units to dispatch of QA-cleared OK devices. Key Responsibilities Intake & Receipt Management Receive faulty/returned terminals from state offices; verify against the recall waybill at serial-number level before accepting into the IMS. Log all received devices in the IMS with correct status within 24 hours of physical arrival. Identify and quarantine damaged or missing-serial devices; raise a Discrepancy Report immediately. Repair Pipeline Tracking Push faulty devices to technicians daily and update IMS status to 'In Repair' upon assignment. Monitor movement of each terminal through all repair stages: Assessment → In Repair → Awaiting QA → QA Cleared → Dispatch Holding. Enforce the 24–72-hour SLA from receipt-to-assignment and from QA clearance-to-dispatch readiness. QA Integration & Status Management Receive QA-approved terminals and update IMS status to 'QA Cleared – Awaiting Dispatch' within 4 hours. Flag devices that fail QA back to the repair queue or classify as 'Beyond Economic Repair (BER)' with a written justification report. Ensure all 'BER' devices are tagged and isolated in the scrap/disposal holding area. Dispatch & Outbound Logistics Generate the Dispatch List and Waybill for QA-cleared refurbished and OK devices; obtain approval from Repair Centre Manager and Cluster lead before release. Scan all devices at serial level during physical loading; update IMS to 'In Transit – Outbound'. Confirm receipt acknowledgment from the destination state SIO and close the dispatch transaction in IMS. Inventory Counts & Reconciliation Conduct daily physical counts of all terminals in the repair centre; reconcile against IMS records. Escalate any variance (physical vs. logical) to the Lead, Inventory Support within the same business day. Participate in monthly, quarterly, and annual wall-to-wall counts as directed by the Inventory & Warehouse Manager. Compliance & Housekeeping Maintain clearly labelled racks and segregated zones: Faulty, Under-Repair, Refurbished/OK, BER/Scrap. Enforce all provisions of the POS Inventory Control SOP within the repair centre. Uphold audit readiness, workplace safety, and environmental handling standards at all times. Reporting Line Functional: Lead, Inventory Support (Regional) Operational: Repair Centre Manager Dotted: Regional Inventory & Warehouse Manager   1B. Inventory Support Officer – Spare Parts Role Purpose The ISO (Spare Parts) manages the complete lifecycle of all repair consumables — batteries, screens, cables, and accessories — within the repair centre. The role ensures that technicians have the right parts at the right time, waste is minimised, and all issues are fully documented and traceable. Key Responsibilities Spare Parts Receipt & Storage Receive all incoming spare parts consignments; verify at batch/serial level against the accompanying delivery note before logging into IMS. Store spare parts in designated, labelled bins organised by part type and model compatibility. Ensure storage conditions protect electronic components from moisture, dust, and extreme temperature. Issuance Control Issue spare parts ONLY against an approved Job Card raised by a technician and validated by the Repair Centre Manager. Update IMS stock levels immediately upon every issuance; zero unrecorded movements. Manage parts returns from technicians (unused or incorrect parts); update IMS accordingly. Inventory Management & Reconciliation Reconcile physical spare parts stock against IMS records on a weekly basis. Identify slow-moving, expired, or obsolete parts and flag to Lead, Inventory Support. Raise a formal replenishment request when stock falls to the defined reorder threshold. Reporting & Documentation Generate weekly spare parts consumption and stock-position reports for the Lead, Inventory Support. Maintain a complete issuance log linking each spare part to its Job Card and technician. Track Part-Failure data to support procurement and OEM quality feedback. Compliance & Housekeeping Maintain proper zoning, labelling, and cleanliness of the spare parts storage area at all times. Enforce segregation of duty: no self-authorised issuance. Support all scheduled and spot-check inventory counts. Requirements  Minimum of OND in a related discipline  At least 2-year experience in inventory operations. Good computer skills. Must know the Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word and PowerPoint)  Ability to work with limited supervision.  Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Proficiency in inventory management systems and workflow applications. Experience handling large volumes of items  Excellent organizational and record-keeping skills. Effective communication and stakeholder coordination. Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

Communication & Influence: Excellent report writing, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across all levels of the organisation. Execution & Leadership: Strong project management capabilities, high attention to detail, ability to manage multiple concurrent audit engagements, and a commitment to coaching and mentoring junior team members. What success looks like in this role Enhanced audit coverage, efficiency, and effectiveness through robust data-driven audit procedures and automated continuous monitoring routines. Proactive identification of control failures, emerging risks, fraud indicators, and operational inefficiencies across all digital channels and payment ecosystems. High-quality, clear, and impactful audit reports delivered with actionable recommendations that improve governance, risk management, and controls. Strong collaborative relationships built across Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, Risk, and Compliance teams. Continuous development and mentoring of audit team members in advanced analytics and digital auditing techniques. Why join us Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities. Opportunity to work with Africa's fastest-growing fintech driving financial inclusion at scale. A collaborative, high-performing environment that invests in innovation, technology, and continuous professional development.

title: Metadata & Data Lineage Specialist

Recognised as Africa’s second-fastest-growing fintech platform and named the Most Inclusive Payment Platform by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) in 2022, Moniepoint continues to scale its profitable financial ecosystem. AI & Advanced Data Discovery: Drive the adoption of AI-assisted metadata management to automate capture, classification, and enrichment. Skills & Competencies Strong proficiency working with technical and business metadata, business glossaries, data domains, and data classification. Experience working with relational databases and a solid understanding of SQL and database structures. Knowledge of APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, and automated metadata integration. Familiarity with AI-assisted metadata management, semantic modelling, ontologies, and knowledge graph concepts. Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to facilitate training and influence adoption. Professional certification in Data Management or Architecture (e.g., DAMA CDMP, CIMP, DCAM) or related platform certifications are advantageous. What success looks like in this role The enterprise data catalogue is accurate, easily discoverable, and heavily utilised by cross-functional teams to understand data assets. End-to-end data lineage is robust, validated, and actively supports critical data products, regulatory submissions, and incident investigations. description: Who We Are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Job Title: Procurement Specialist (Branch Roll-out Projects) Department: Third Party Management & Procurement Reports to: Head, Third Party Management & Procurement Location: Lagos, Nigeria (with nationwide oversight) About this role The Procurement Specialist will lead the end-to-end strategic sourcing, market real estate acquisition, commercial lease negotiation, vendor onboarding, and contract management for Moniepoint MFB’s nationwide physical expansion. This pivotal role ensures the timely, cost-effective, and quality-driven rollout of regional offices and branch experience centers across major Nigerian cities—including Lagos, Benin, and Gombe (Q3). The successful candidate will act as the commercial anchor for capital expenditure (CapEx) and real estate portfolio growth, executing a quick turnaround of physical property requirements into commercial reality while mitigating supply chain risks in a fast-paced fintech/banking ecosystem. Responsibilities Real Estate Procurement & Site Acquisition Lead the active market search, identification, and commercial evaluation of prospective real estate assets across target states to secure properties optimized for Moniepoint’s operational needs. Target and assess properties matching specific spatial templates, focusing on open-plan framed structures or multi-level standalone commercial buildings. Spearhead high-stakes commercial lease negotiations and acquisitions, locking in competitive rental rates, favorable rent-free fit-out periods, flexible renewal clauses, and long-term tenure security. Partner closely with internal Legal counsel and certified estate surveyors to conduct rigorous due diligence, verifying land titles, freedom from statutory encumbrances, and structural viability before finalizing acquisitions. Strategic Sourcing & Category Management Develop and execute a centralized procurement strategy tailored for nationwide, multi-site branch rollouts and building retrofits. Create a robust, pre-qualified vendor matrix across Nigeria for construction professionals, civil works sub-contractors, specialist installers and suppliers. Standardize pricing agreements and supply chains for recurring brand-specific elements, such as custom Brand cladding systems, office partitioning systems, curtain-wall systems, and high-impact exterior LED signage systems. Including vendor management for suppliers of vault doors, security doors, mantrap doors and security infrastructure installations. Establish strategic relationships with global and local manufacturers to de-risk long-lead import items (e.g., facade cladding systems, precision cooling systems, and alternative power components). title: Product Auditor
description: Who We Are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. What We Do At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. Role Overview The Product Auditor provides independent assurance over the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of product controls across payment, wallet, settlement, switches and other related products across the organisation The role ensures that new and existing products are deployed with adequate financial, operational, security, and regulatory controls, safeguarding the organization against revenue leakage, settlement failures, regulatory breaches, and technology-driven risks. The Product Auditor will independently evaluate product risk exposure and control maturity prior to scale. Key Responsibilities  Audit Universe & Risk-Based Planning Maintain a living Product Audit Universe covering all payment products, features, and integrations ranked by risk.  Own the annual Product Audit Plan, ensuring coverage is allocated dynamically based on risk ratings, product complexity, regulatory sensitivity, and change velocity. Product Design & Control Assurance Review PRDs, business rules, and transaction workflows to identify logic gaps, unmitigated risk paths, and missing exception-handling routines before products reach production/go-live.  Analyse product path scenarios, verify Maker-Checker enforcement, and provide formal control design sign-off before any material release goes live. Live Product Assessment ( Continuous Audit Review) Periodically assess live payment products to confirm they continue to operate within approved design parameters.  Detect configuration drift, identify silent divergence from original PRDs, and analyse live transaction data for emerging risk patterns. Go-Live Readiness & Control Gate Execute mandatory pre-production Product Audit reviews as an independent control gate for all material releases.  Confirm reconciliation logic, exception queues, and fallback controls are tested and functional.  Escalate critical deficiencies with risk ratings and hold recommendations where a product is not safe to release. Transaction Logic & Mathematical Integrity Interrogate the Fee Engine using SQL to mathematically prove that commissions, VAT, discounts, and splits are posted with complete precision.  Validate duplicate prevention mechanisms and ensure transaction integrity within complex, multi-step payment sequences, and test reversal, refund, and chargeback logic to confirm financial symmetry is maintained in every scenario. Settlement & Ledger Integrity Trace fund flows, confirming continuous synchronisation between wallet sub-ledgers and the General Ledger.  Assess reconciliation logic for breaks and evaluate the authorisation, documentation, and reversibility of manual settlement overrides. Product Change & Configuration Integrity Confirm that all product modifications: fee tables, routing rules, limit parameters passed through an approved change management cycle.  Identify silent changes made outside formal release processes and audit the integrity of product master data to ensure it is access-controlled, version-tracked, and consistent with approved product terms. Vendor & Third-Party Product Risk Assess controls over vendor-managed product components, evaluate SLA performance against contractual commitments, and identify single-vendor dependency risks within critical payment flows.  Evaluate the organisation's ability to detect unilateral changes in third-party API behaviour, fee logic, or settlement processes. Control Advisory & Stakeholder Engagement Engage product and engineering teams early in the design cycle to provide informal control advisory, reducing findings at the formal review stage without compromising independence.  Participate in design reviews and architecture discussions, and build a control-by-design culture across product teams.  Incident Review, RCA & Regulatory Alignment Lead post-incident reviews for product failures,producing structured RCA reports that identify underlying logic failures, not just surface symptoms.  Assess corrective actions for adequacy and track findings to verify closure.  Ensure product logic complies with CBN guidelines, PCI DSS, and consumer protection obligations at the design level, and evaluate the regulatory impact of new features before release. Reporting & Governance Prepare risk-rated audit reports for Executive Management and the Audit Committee, leading with findings, financial impact, and required action.  Maintain a Product Risk Register, deliver quarterly control maturity updates, and ensure governance bodies are never surprised by a product failure that was visible at the design or portfolio review stage. Required Knowledge & Skills  Technical Skills Advanced SQL for independent data extraction and transaction interrogation Payment systems architecture : Wallets, card processing, direct debit, settlement, and reconciliation API and integration literacy (Basic) End-to-end transaction lifecycle knowledge: Authorisation, posting, clearing, settlement, and exception handling PRD and process flow analysis: translating product documentation into control flowcharts Mathematical precision: fee calculations, interest computations, and split payment structures Pattern recognition: detecting anomalies, outliers, and irregularities in large transaction datasets Audit & Risk Skills Risk-based audit methodology: IIA Standards and COSO framework applied to financial products. Control design logic and evaluation Root cause analysis Regulatory knowledge: CBN payment system regulations, PCI DSS, NDPR,Nigerian consumer protection obligations etc Interpersonal & Professional Skills Stakeholder engagement Professional scepticism and independence Risk-rated report writing Tools & Platforms SQL (PostgreSQL / MySQL / MSSQL) AdvancedExcel / Google Sheets Claude / AI Tools Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative discipline Experience: 3–5+ years in Product Audit, Systems Audit, Financial Data Analytics, or Payment Operations within a fintech or financial services environment Certifications: CISA, CIA, or CFE preferred. ACA / ACCA is acceptable when combined with strong technical product experience and data analytics. Sector Knowledge: Demonstrated hands-on familiarity with payment product architecture, wallet systems, and regulated payment flows in a Nigerian or comparable market context. What We Offer You Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’re human, we listen, and we look out for one another. Learning: We’re big on growth. You’ll find an environment focused on knowledge sharing, training, and helping you reach your potential. Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, and an annual bonus, along with other great benefits. What to Expect in the Hiring Process A preliminary phone call with our recruiter. An interview with the hiring team. A final conversation with a member of our executive team. Moniepoint Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Product Design Manager - Design System
description: Who we are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial ecosystem, helping 10 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, and business management tools since 2019. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, it powers most of the country’s Point of Sale (POS) transactions. Through its subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes $22 billion monthly for its customers while operating profitably. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. About the role  Designing for money means designing for trust. Our customers are shop owners, traders and entrepreneurs, and many are new to digital products. They work on low-end devices and unreliable networks, where one confusing screen can cost them a sale. Your team's work has to hold up for them, whatever their ability or device. You make sure it does.  As a Design Manager, you'll lead a small team of product designers and be accountable for everything they ship: its quality, how it works as one product, and the results it drives for our customers and the business. Your team works either on the products our customers use on POS, mobile and web, or on the operational tools our teams use to serve them.  It is a hands-on role: you build the systems the team works within and step into the hardest problems yourself.  What you'll do  Set the design direction for your area, turn it into plans with milestones and measurable outcomes, and make the case for it to senior leaders in customer and business terms. Work with product partners so every designer begins from a clear, well-framed brief, and push back early when one isn't ready.  Keep each customer journey whole across teams, and resolve conflicting designs before they launch.  Run critique and design reviews against a definition of done that includes accessibility, and stay close enough to the work that nothing reaches customers below the bar. Decide what must be tested with customers before build and what can ship and be measured after, and plan that validation into delivery with success metrics defined up front. Make sure journeys use the design system, with market and product variations handled inside it rather than as one-off rebuilds. Plan and staff system contributions like any other project. Build trusted partnerships with product and engineering, so design shapes what gets built, and design and engineering stay in step through build.  Hire well, set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and build a growth path for each designer.  Bring AI tools into the team's design process, model effective and responsible use in your own work, and build that fluency across the team.  What you'll need to succeed  10+ years of experience in product design, with a portfolio of shipped work across mobile and web that shows the problem, your decisions and the results.  3+ years of experience managing product designers, including hiring, coaching and career development.  Experience setting design direction for a product area and leading a team to deliver it. Experience running a design quality practice, such as critique, design reviews and a definition of done, that raised the quality of shipped work.  Experience building shared patterns or templates adopted across teams, products or markets. Experience shipping accessible, inclusive products for people with disabilities, people new to digital products and people on limited devices and connectivity.  Experience using AI tools in design work and building that fluency across a team.  Nice to have  Experience designing for POS terminals is a strong plus. Experience in financial services, multiple markets or operational tools is also welcome.  What you will get: A leadership role in shaping the future of fintech - your work will impact millions of users. Career growth opportunities. A culture of experimentation - we encourage innovative thinking and rapid iteration. Competitive compensation and benefits. Remote-friendly work culture, with access to learning resources. What to expect in the hiring process  Recruiter conversation. Your background, what you want next, and practical details. 2. Case study review. Walk a design leader through one or two case studies in depth: one from your own work, one from a team you led.  Leadership challenge. Work through a product and team problem live with two design leaders.  Final interview. A conversation with the hiring manager. Why Join Us Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities. Fully remote work culture and support for professional development. What to expect in the hiring process Application & portfolio review: we assess your experience, leadership impact, and Design System case studies that demonstrate strategic thinking, process, and measurable outcomes. Preliminary phone call with recruiter: a brief conversation to discuss your background, leadership experience, and expectations. Interview with senior leadership: a deep dive into your leadership approach, design philosophy, and ability to drive impact. This includes a discussion on past projects and collaboration with cross-functional teams. Design leadership challenge: a scenario-based assessment to assess both strategic thinking and leadership skills while balancing UX/UI expertise. Final executive conversation: a discussion with senior leadership to assess alignment with our vision, strategic thinking, and team-building philosophy. How to apply: Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your leadership in managing design teams, driving strategy, and delivering user-centred solutions with measurable business impact. We want to see case studies that demonstrate how you have led and developed designers, prioritised and managed projects, and fostered a high-performing team culture. Your portfolio should highlight how you have used research, data, and experimentation to inform decisions, optimise workflows, and drive success metrics.

title: Regional Lead, Client Implementation
description: Who We Are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. What We Do At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. Job Purpose The Implementation Lead is responsible for building, managing, and continuously improving a high-performing regional team of Implementation agents. This role drives the strategic execution of Moniebook's customer onboarding programme at scale, ensuring that every new retail customer in the region is successfully activated, trained, and transitioned into a confident, long-term user of the Moniebook solution. Operating at the intersection of people leadership, operational excellence, and customer success strategy, the Implementation Lead sets performance standards, develops team capability, removes escalation blockers, and partners cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Account Management to deliver a world-class onboarding experience. Success is measured by team-wide activation rates, time-to-value benchmarks, retention outcomes, and the quality of customer handoffs across the region measure success. Key Responsibilities Team Leadership & Performance Management Recruit, onboard, coach, and retain a regional team of Implementation Agents, fostering a culture of accountability, customer obsession, and continuous improvement. Set clear individual and team performance goals aligned to activation rates, time-to-value, feature adoption, CSAT scores, and churn reduction targets. Conduct regular 1:1s, team reviews, and performance evaluations; identify skill gaps and build development plans to close them. Onboarding Strategy & Programme Oversight Design scalable onboarding frameworks that allow the team to manage growing customer volumes without compromising on quality or personalisation. Define and maintain onboarding milestones, success metrics, and quality standards across all customer segments. Identify opportunities to streamline onboarding timelines and reduce time-to-value without sacrificing adoption depth. Escalation Management & Issue Resolution Act as the first point of escalation for complex technical issues, difficult customer situations, or onboarding stalls that agents are unable to resolve independently. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Support teams to drive resolution of systemic issues affecting onboarding outcomes across the region. Maintain clear escalation pathways and SLA standards, ensuring customers always feel supported and informed during issue resolution. Cross-functional Collaboration Partner closely with the Sales team to ensure smooth pre-to-post sale handoffs and that customer expectations are properly set before onboarding begins. Collaborate with Account Managers to refine the handoff process, ensuring agents provide complete, high-quality context that enables seamless long-term retention. Work with the Product team to surface recurring customer pain points, usability gaps, and feature adoption blockers, acting as a regional voice of the customer. Data, Reporting & Insights Track and analyse team-wide performance data including activation rates, onboarding completion timelines, feature adoption depth, CSAT scores, and early-stage churn metrics. Produce regular reports for senior leadership on regional onboarding health, trends, risks, and improvement initiatives. Use data to identify underperforming segments, agents, or onboarding touchpoints, and drive targeted interventions to address root causes. Process Improvement & Innovation Continuously review and refine onboarding processes, tools, and resources to improve efficiency, consistency, and customer outcomes. Champion the adoption of new technologies, automation, or methodologies that can enhance the team's ability to deliver high-touch onboarding at scale. Build a feedback loop between frontline agent insights and senior leadership/product decisions to ensure ground-level learnings influence the business. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Operations, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 4 - 6 years of experience in customer onboarding, customer success, or implementation roles, with at least 2–3 years in a team lead or people management capacity. Proven track record of leading onboarding or CS teams to consistently achieve activation, adoption, and retention targets, ideally within SaaS, retail technology, or fintech. Strong people leadership skills with the ability to motivate, develop, and hold a distributed team accountable for outcomes. Excellent analytical skills, able to interpret customer health data, team performance metrics, and identify actionable trends. Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills; able to present to senior leadership, navigate cross-functional relationships, and represent the customer voice persuasively. Deep customer empathy combined with a results-driven orientation. Highly organised with demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and escalations simultaneously without compromising quality. Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments; brings structure and clarity without over-engineering. Preferred Qualifications Experience building or scaling onboarding teams from the ground up in a high-growth technology company. Exposure to retail operations, merchant services, or point-of-sale technology. Experience designing training curricula, onboarding playbooks, or knowledge management systems. Familiarity with customer health scoring methodologies, NPS/CSAT frameworks, or CS operations best practices. About You You are a natural leader who takes genuine pride in developing the people around you, and you measure your success by the success of your team and your customers. You are strategic and execution-focused; you can zoom out to design the right system and zoom in to resolve a customer escalation on the same day. You bring calm, clarity, and decisiveness under pressure. When things go wrong, your team looks to you and finds confidence, not panic. You are deeply data-literate; you use numbers to tell stories, make decisions, and hold yourself and your team accountable. You are a collaborative partner who builds trust across functions, Sales, Product, Support, and Account Management, and all see you as an ally, not a blocker. You thrive in environments where the playbook is still being written, and you take ownership of writing it. You are customer-obsessed at scale, even as you move further from direct customer interaction, you never lose sight of the human beings behind the metrics. What Success Looks Like Your regional team consistently achieves 90%+ customer activation rates within the 30–60 day onboarding window, month over month. Average time-to-live for customers in your region is at or below the 1–2 week target, with no systemic delays attributed to onboarding execution gaps. Regional post-onboarding CSAT scores average 4.5+, and your team's handoff quality is rated as excellent by Account Managers. Early-stage churn (within 90 days post-onboarding) for customers in your region remains below 5%. Your agents are among the most skilled and engaged at Moniebook, attrition on your team is low, development is visible, and performance is strong. You have documented, improved, and operationalised at least two significant enhancements to the regional onboarding playbook each quarter. What we can offer you Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human. title: Senior Principal, Talent Marketing
description: About us Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times as Africa's fastest-growing fintech, Moniepoint is trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of dollars in transactions monthly. Having built resilient, high-volume financial infrastructure that powers commerce across emerging markets, Moniepoint is embarking on its next phase of global scale. About this role As our Senior Principal, Talent Marketing, you will be the strategic architect responsible for establishing Moniepoint's talent brand and candidate pipeline in new markets from scratch. Where Moniepoint is not yet an established consumer brand, you will solve complex talent acquisition problems by understanding how senior engineers, engineering managers, and technical leaders think, connect, and evaluate career moves across Europe. Working from a blank piece of paper with high autonomy, you will translate our global Employer Value Proposition (EVP) into localized, high-converting talent marketing strategies. You will bridge the gap between Talent Acquisition, Engineering Leadership, and Brand - combining developer community immersion, high-touch physical events, and targeted campaigns that turn brand discovery into qualified, closed engineering hires.   Responsibilities 1. Zero-to-One Market Entry & Tech Hub Architecture Define European Hub Talent Strategy: Architect and lead the talent go-to-market strategy for Moniepoint's newest engineering hubs (principally Poland and Spain), crafting localized narratives that appeal to discerning software engineers. Anchor the 'Founding Team' Narrative: Position early European engineering cohorts as foundational builders, creating compelling narratives around technical scale, system complexity, and ownership that resonate with elite technical talent. Navigate Market Nuances: Diagnose and navigate country-specific developer dynamics—recognizing that developer communities in Poland, Spain, and the UK behave differently and require tailored engagement models rather than copy-pasted playbooks. 2. Developer Community, Ecosystem & Event Activation High-Impact Physical & Virtual Presence: Conceive, curate, and lead our physical presence at key developer conferences, engineering meetups, hackathons, and university partnerships across target markets. End-to-End Pipeline Activation: Ensure events are never vanity exercises; architect end-to-end follow-up systems and talent nurture funnels that convert event attendees into active, screened pipelines for our TA partners. Developer Platform Immersion: Leverage deep knowledge of where engineers consume information (e.g., GitLab/GitHub communities, tech forums, Discord/Slack groups, Meetup, Eventbrite) to drive authentic engagement. 3. Strategic Hiring Campaigns & Technical Enablement Targeted Campaign Architecture: Partner with TA leads and Engineering Directors to identify acute hiring bottlenecks and build agile, multi-channel marketing campaigns that address specialized, hard-to-fill tech disciplines. Technical EVP Translation: Translate technical architecture, distributed systems challenges, and fintech infrastructure realities into authentic, intellectually rigorous technical messaging that outshines local competitors. Recruiter Enablement & Narrative Toolkits: Equip our technical sourcing and recruitment teams with high-leverage narrative assets—outbound pitch decks, technical one-pagers, culture collateral, and messaging sequences that double recruiter outreach conversion. 4. Performance, Analytics & Optimization Hiring-Centric Metrics: Discard vanity metrics. Evaluate every initiative against pipeline contribution, qualified applicant rates, candidate quality score, cost-per-hire, and time-to-fill. Budget Oversight: Own and allocate dedicated talent marketing budgets with extreme commercial discipline—scaling programs that drive measurable hires and rapidly decommissioning initiatives that underdeliver. Paid Acquisition (Tactical Lever): Oversee and strategically deploy paid recruitment marketing spend across relevant technical platforms and channels when targeted outbound and community channels require acceleration. 5. Strategic Leadership & Scalability Strategic Thought Partnership: Serve as the trusted advisor to the Head of Talent Acquisition, VP of Engineering, and Brand Leadership on talent market intelligence, competitor positioning, and developer sentiment. Playbook Documentation: Establish and document Moniepoint's global talent expansion playbook, creating scalable frameworks that will be deployed across future international markets. Mentorship & Functional Growth: Provide strategic guidance to broader TA and brand team members, with the opportunity to mentor or direct junior talent marketing specialists as the function scales. Experience & Background 8+ Years of Talent Marketing Leadership: Experience leading talent marketing, technical recruitment marketing, or developer relations/advocacy, with substantial time dedicated to hiring software engineering and product disciplines. European Market Expertise: Demonstrated experience building talent brand presence and hiring pipelines across European tech ecosystems (particularly Central/Eastern Europe such as Poland, and Western/Southern Europe such as the UK or Spain). Zero-to-One Market Entry Track Record: Proven success entering new geographies or scaling talent brand where the employer brand was nascent or non-existent, creating playbooks from a blank sheet of paper. Fintech & Scale Exposure: Experience in hyper-growth fintech, high-frequency/payments infrastructure, or high-scale distributed systems environments. International Collaboration: Experience collaborating with international founding teams or distributed tech hubs across emerging and mature markets. Skills & Competencies Mastery in Event-Driven Pipeline Activation: Extensive hands-on experience designing and executing physical and digital developer events and architecting the subsequent candidate nurturing journey that yields hires. Deep Engineering Domain Fluency: Genuine understanding of software engineering culture, tech stacks (distributed systems, backend, infra, DevOps), and developer channels (Meetup, Eventbrite, GitLab/GitHub, Reddit, tech conferences). Comfort with Substantial Ambiguity: High agency and entrepreneurial drive; ability to make decisive bets, test hypotheses, and build structure in fast-moving, high-growth environments. Strategic Campaign Design: Ability to connect high-level EVP strategy to pragmatic, sprint-based talent acquisition sprints that deliver on an aggressive hiring plan (500+ tech hires). Paid Digital Campaign Optimization: Direct experience running and optimizing paid digital recruitment advertising campaigns independently across social and developer networks. What success looks like in this role First 30 Days (Discovery & Immersion): Map the competitive landscape and developer talent dynamics in Poland and Spain. Establish alignment with technical hiring leads (PEP, Engineering Directors) and TA leads to define immediate priority pipelines. Audit existing employer brand collateral and identify localized messaging gaps for European tech hiring. First 90 Days (Initial Market Entry & Quick Wins): Launch the first pilot physical event / developer meetup presence in Poland with a complete post-event pipeline conversion funnel. Roll out the European Recruiter Enablement Toolkit (localized pitch decks, outreach sequences, and technical one-pagers). Launch targeted marketing sprints for top 3 hardest-to-fill senior technical roles. First 6 Months (Hub Establishment & Pipeline Ramp): Position Moniepoint as a recognized, compelling engineering hub in Poland, supporting the identity and pride of the founding engineer cohort. Consistently contribute qualified, pre-warmed candidate pipelines directly supporting the ramp toward 500 tech/product hires. Prove multi-channel attribution showing which community and marketing initiatives are yielding quality hires. Year One (Global Expansion Playbook): Complete Moniepoint's International Talent Expansion Playbook, ready to be deployed across future tech hubs. Measurably decrease time-to-fill and increase direct outbound response rates across all European technical roles. Solidify Moniepoint's reputation as an employer of choice for Europe's most ambitious engineers. Why join us High-Impact Mission: Play a career-defining role in building the engineering backbone of Africa's fastest-growing fintech as it scales globally. True Ownership & Dedicated Resources: Autonomy to build from scratch with dedicated budget backing and direct executive sponsorship. Front-Row Seat to Tech Hub Creation: Help build engineering hubs from their inception, shaping culture, talent standards, and brand identity. Competitive Executive Package: Competitive base salary (calibrated for Senior Principal level), performance bonuses, comprehensive private healthcare, and pension schemes. Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

What you need to succeed 5+ years in a senior product design role, with a strong focus on UX and a demonstrated ability to lead impactful projects Mastery of visual design, typography, grids, layout, and colour theory. Expertise in interaction design, information architecture, and user flows. Deep understanding of designing for both mobile and web platforms, ensuring responsive and adaptive experiences. Strong knowledge of behavioural psychology and how it influences user decision-making. Extensive experience conducting usability testing, user interviews, and heuristic evaluations. Ability to synthesise qualitative and quantitative insights into impactful design decisions. Familiarity with UX analytics tools (Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Hotjar, etc.). Proficiency in atomic design principles and building scalable UI frameworks. Strong knowledge of motion design tools (Lottie, After Effects, Principle) to create dynamic user experiences. Experience mentoring and guiding junior designers. Ability to articulate design rationale and influence stakeholders across teams. Comfortable working in agile, fast-paced product teams. Figma mastery - deep experience with auto layout, design tokens, component variants, interactive prototypes, and scalable design libraries. Proven experience in fintech and/or SaaS environments, with a strong understanding of industry challenges and user behaviours. What you’ll get A leadership role in shaping the future of fintech - your work will impact millions of users. Career growth opportunities. A culture of experimentation - we encourage innovative thinking and rapid iteration. Competitive compensation and benefits. Remote-friendly work culture, with access to learning resources. title: Senior UX Researcher
description: About us Moniepoint is an all-in-one financial services platform for emerging markets and the second-fastest growing company in Africa.Since 2019, Moniepoint’s technology has powered over 3 million people, offering personal and business banking, payment, credit and business management tools to help them succeed. Moniepoint processed $182 billion in 2023, and currently processes the majority of the POS transactions in Nigeria.  Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. About the role As a Senior UX researcher, you’ll be the voice of our users. You’ll play a critical role in shaping our product strategy by uncovering deep insights into the needs, behaviours, and aspirations of our users—especially within Nigeria. We’re on a mission to create financial happiness for every African, and your research will directly influence how we design products that are accessible, intuitive, and impactful. You’ll collaborate closely with our creators to ensure our solutions are grounded in real-world market realities. Key responsibilities Lead and execute end-to-end qualitative and quantitative research across the product lifecycle—from discovery to delivery. Use a range of methods including in-depth interviews, ethnographic studies, usability testing, surveys, and diary studies, with a focus on the Nigerian context. Synthesise complex data into actionable insights and frameworks (personas, journey maps, mental models) that drive empathy across the team. Stay ahead of fintech and consumer trends in Nigeria and comparable markets through continuous landscape analysis. Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to translate business challenges into research questions. Act as the subject matter expert on Nigerian user needs, guiding our local expansion and regional growth across Africa. Structure and scale our research operations, including participant management and maintaining organised research repositories. Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels to drive action and product improvements. Qualifications 6+ years of experience in UX research or product research, ideally with digital B2C products. Deep experience researchng African markets, specifically Nigeria. Advanced expertise in qualitative and quantitative methodologies (co-creation, usability testing, literature reviews, etc.). Hands-on experience with tools like UserTesting, Maze, Typeform, or similar platforms. Proven track record of translating insights into tangible frameworks that guide business decisions. Preferred qualifications Experience building or engaging with active user communities in Nigeria. Background in fintech or banking environments. Experience scaling research practices in a fast-growth startup or scale-up. About you  You're driven by mastery and want to make the world a better place through your work. You love finding innovative ways to solve user problems. You speak the language of our users. You don't try to sound impressive with technical jargon; you stay relatable and friendly. You don't guess—you use data. You prefer not to speak if you're unsure of the facts.  You believe in Moniepoint’s mission and want to bring our audience along on the journey to financial happiness. What success looks like Product teams report a clearer understanding of user pain points, measured by feature adoption and user satisfaction. Research insights are consistently used to inform the product roadmap and business strategy. We establish a thriving research repository that is easily accessible to all product stakeholders. User recruitment becomes a seamless, automated process that allows for faster research cycles. You become the "go-to" person for understanding the Nigerian consumer’s financial journey. Please submit a resume highlighting your research experience and outlining research methodologies, processes, and the impact of your work on user experience and business outcomes. Optionally, you may also include a PDF portfolio with case studies that further illustrate your research approach and results. While a portfolio is not required, it can provide additional insight into your end-to-end research thinking and influence on product direction. Our hiring process Resume review: We look for strong experience that showcases your research process, methodologies, and impact. Technical interview with a senior researcher: Deep dive into your experience, approach, and alignment with our mission. Case study presentation: Present a research project to a panel, demonstrating your problem-solving, research craft, and strategic thinking. Executive interview: Discussion with senior leadership about your growth potential, influence, and ability to drive user and business success.

title: Staff Product Designer
description: Who we are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial ecosystem, helping 10 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, and business management tools since 2019. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, it powers most of the country’s Point of Sale (POS) transactions. Through its subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes $22 billion monthly for its customers while operating profitably. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. About the role  As a Staff Product Designer, you will take on our largest and most ambiguous design problems and set the long-term design direction for your product area. You will shape what we build as well as how it works: complex journeys, patterns other teams depend on, and the questions that decide what comes next.  Designing for money means designing for trust, often for people on low-end devices and unreliable internet connections, and your work will set the standard for how we do that.  You will join one of our product teams, working either on the products our customers use on POS, mobile and web, or on the operational tools our teams use to serve them. Your home team is where your work starts, not where it ends. The journeys you design and the patterns you create will cut across several teams, so you will work closely with designers, product managers and engineers on those teams to make sure the product holds together as one experience.  This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you will lead through your work and your influence, partnering with design, product and engineering leaders, with support from researchers and content designers.  What you'll do  Own the design of our most complex work end to end, from discovery through launch and beyond.  Set the long-term design direction for your product area, thinking ahead to where the product is going so teams can plan and build towards it.  Work with product and engineering leaders to decide what we build and why, starting from the problem, not the solution.  Think in systems, creating templates and patterns that can be configured and reused, and partner with our design system team to shape its direction.  Set the bar for accessibility and inclusion in your product area and help other teams reach it, so our products work for everyone, whatever their ability, device, internet connection or level of digital literacy. Spot where features built by different teams overlap or conflict, and bring those teams to one design that works across the whole product.  Shape our biggest product bets by testing them with customers and data before we commit to building them.  Stay with the work through build so that what ships matches what was designed, then measure its impact on customers and the business and keep improving it. Present your work with conviction and defend your decisions to senior leadership. Mentor designers and lead critique, raising the bar for design beyond your own work.  What you need to succeed  10+ years of product design experience, with recent hands-on work on large, ambiguous problems.  Exceptional interaction and visual design craft across mobile and web, with a sharp eye for hierarchy, typography, layout and detail.  A portfolio of shipped work that shows how you framed the problem, your role, the direction you set and what changed as a result, with the evidence to back it. Experience leading work that spans several teams or product areas, and bringing designers, product managers and engineers behind a shared direction. Experience setting design direction and influencing what gets built, working with senior product and engineering leaders.  Strong systems thinking, with patterns or templates that other designers have adopted. A track record of shipping accessible, inclusive products, and the ability to show the decisions you made for people with disabilities, low digital literacy or limited devices. Fluency in both research and data: you know which questions each can answer, and you use them to set direction and to judge whether shipped work succeeded. The confidence to defend your design decisions to senior leadership, and the judgment to change course on evidence.  Experience mentoring designers and leading design critique.  Curiosity about customers whose devices, connectivity and digital habits differ from your own.  Hands-on experience using AI tools to explore and prototype faster, while owning the judgment and the quality of the result.  Nice to have  Experience designing for POS terminals is a strong plus. Experience in financial services, multiple markets or operational tools is also welcome.  What you’ll get A leadership role in shaping the future of fintech - your work will impact millions of users. Career growth opportunities. A culture of experimentation - we encourage innovative thinking and rapid iteration. Competitive compensation and benefits. Remote-friendly work culture, with access to learning resources. What to expect in the hiring process Application & portfolio review: we look for strong UX case studies that showcase process, research, impact, and leadership. Preliminary phone call with the recruiter: a brief conversation to discuss your background, interests, and expectations. Interview with a design team member: a discussion about your experience, approach to design, alignment with our mission, and a portfolio walkthrough. Design Challenge: an advanced exercise to assess problem-solving, UX/UI craft, and strategic thinking. Final executive conversation: a discussion with senior leadership about your ability to think strategically, collaborate across teams, and drive business and user impact through design.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description: Who we are Moniepoint is an all-in-one financial services platform for emerging markets and the second-fastest growing company in Africa.Since 2019, Moniepoint’s technology has powered over 3 million people, offering personal and business banking, payment, credit and business management tools to help them succeed. Moniepoint processed $1 Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. About the role You will join a smart, collaborative and passionate team of Recruiters. We take pride in the art of hiring and retaining talent across different functions. As a recruiter, you will partner directly with hiring managers and own end-to-end recruitment. The ideal candidate for this role should have a good understanding of different business functions, good communication skills, good interpersonal skills, strategic thinking, and good organizational skills.  If you thrive in a collaborative team setting, enjoy ownership of your work, and take pride in providing exceptional candidate experience, this might be the role for you, and we would like to hear from you! What you’ll get to do Managing end-to-end recruitment process: from job intake, sourcing, scheduling to interviewing, offer negotiation, hiring and onboarding. Engaging in proactive recruitment strategies to generate pipelines of qualified candidates for current and future needs. Working closely with hiring managers at all levels to identify current and upcoming staffing needs and build long-lasting working relationships. Assist in implementing various HR initiatives, including providing recommendations on process and program improvements Facilitate day to day employee relations, including complaint resolution Coordinate, administer and facilitate the performance management and talent management for employees Support the execution of HR strategies, policies, procedures, and programs to sustain continued growth and retention To succeed in this role, we think you should have: An educational background in human resources and/or a relevant technical program is required. Minimum 5 years relevant work experience including experience in full life-cycle recruitment, working closely with hiring managers and candidates. Experience as both an agency recruiter and as an In-house recruiter Out-of-the-box thinking when it comes to sourcing, candidate management and candidate experience. Experience hiring for both Technical and Non-Technical roles (Engineering, Business and Commercial positions) Highly self-motivated and directed; ability to execute tasks in a fast-paced environment. Experience working with Human Resources Information Systems and Applicant Tracking Systems. Strong relationship-building skills with stakeholders, team members and candidates. Strong negotiation and persuasion skills. Exceptional organization skills and a keen attention to detail. High business acumen with the ability to align departmental projects & key business objectives. What we can offer you Culture -We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human. Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks. Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits. What to expect in the hiring process A preliminary phone call with the recruiter A technical interview with the talent acquisition team A take-home assignment A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team.  How to apply: please send us your CV or LinkedIn profile via our career website. Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Team Lead, Site Reliability Engineering
description: Who we are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. Job SummaryWe are seeking a Team Lead, SRE to guide a squad of site reliability engineers responsible for the reliability of our highly distributed financial platform. You will be designing high-level reliability architecture, while also mentoring engineers, defining the technical roadmap, and driving the culture of Site Reliability Engineering within a team. You will balance strategic leadership with deep technical work to ensure our systems and our people can scale linearly with our hyper-growth. Responsibilities Set the technical direction for the SRE team. Architect self-healing systems, define reliability standards (Production Readiness Reviews), and drive the adoption of observability as Code and automation best practices. Define and enforce the end-to-end standard for system visibility. You will guide teams to deeply instrument their code (logging, tracing, metrics) and govern the monitoring ecosystem to ensure alerts are actionable, strictly minimizing noise (alert fatigue) while maximizing our ability to detect and resolve issues proactively. Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Senior and Associate SREs. Conduct code reviews, facilitate technical workshops and foster a culture of engineering excellence. Act as the ultimate escalation point for major incidents. Beyond firefighting, you will refine the Incident management process, ensuring the process is efficient and that RCAs lead to actionable engineering fixes.  Partner with Engineering Managers and Product Leads to define Service Level Objectives (SLOs) that align with business goals.  Requirements Minimum of 6 years of experience in SRE or Backend Engineering, with at least 2 years in a Lead or Senior/Staff role mentoring others. Expert-level proficiency in Java, Go, Rust, or Python. You set the standard for code quality within the team. Mastery of distributed systems patterns. You can design scalable architectures, debug complex microservices interactions, and explain architectural trade-offs to stakeholders. Deep expertise with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS.  You have extensive experience running Kubernetes (GKE) at scale and troubleshooting deep infrastructure issues. Proven experience defining observability strategies for large teams. You have deep expertise in architecting the complete telemetry stack: from custom instrumentation to monitoring and actionable alerting. Strong communication skills with the ability to de-escalate high-pressure war rooms with calm authority. What we can offer you Culture - We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human. Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks. Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.
